items.text:
Insist  to  demand  something  firmly  or persistently. Stay to remain in a place or position. Sol.363.(c) Hermits  individuals  who choose  to  live  in seclusion,  often  for religious or spiritual reasons. Anchorites  religious  recluse  who  lives alone, often in seclusion  for  spiritual reasons. Wanderers -individuals who travel without a fixed destination or purpose. Pirates  people  who  engage  in  acts  of robbery and violence at sea. Sailors people who navigate or work on ships at sea.
Sol.364.(c) Inactivity  the  state  of  not engaging in any activity. Inertia  a  tendency  to  do  nothing  or to remain unchanged. Progression  the process of developing or moving  gradually towards  a  more advanced state. Activeness -engaging  in  physical  or mental activity. Energy  the  capacity  to  do  work  or cause change.
Sol.365.(d) Hate to feel strong dislike or aversion towards something or someone. Loathe to feel intense dislike or disgust for. Love -an intense feeling of deep affection. Esteem to respect and admire deeply. Dissipate  to scatter  or disperse;  to waste resources.
